name: Southwest Ridge

rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 1 of 2, double-rope, to the notch between Middle and South Gunsight.
rappel_detail.anchor: south-facing rappel anchor near the summit
rappel_detail.station: Traverse south along the summit ridge from the top to the south-facing rappel anchors.

rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 2 of 2, double-rope, into the moat at the base of the notch.
rappel_detail.anchor: anchor at the Middle-South Gunsight notch
hazards: Loose, dirty and cold. Then navigate the crevasse field on the Chickamin Glacier back to camp.
rappel_detail.station: The notch between Middle and South Gunsight.

rappels: 2 double-rope rappels: one from near the summit to the notch between Middle and South Gunsight, one more into the moat at the base of the notch. With only one 60 m rope expect more; no single-rope count is published.
descent_text: From the summit, traverse south along the summit ridge to the south-facing rappel anchors and make two double-rope rappels: the first to the notch between Middle and South Gunsight, the second into the moat at the base of the notch (loose, dirty and cold). With a single 60 m rope expect more rappels. From the glacier, reverse the approach: descend roughly 5,000 ft back to Agnes Creek and hike out 9-10 miles to High Bridge.
approach: The east-side multi-day approach: Lady of the Lake ferry from Chelan to Stehekin, NPS shuttle to High Bridge, ~9-10 miles on the PCT/Agnes Creek Trail, then an off-trail bushwhack and glacier approach (~5,000 ft gain) to a high camp below the peaks.
overview: A short, classic 5-pitch ridge route up Middle Gunsight's southwest side, starting with loose blocky climbing and finishing with enjoyable, easier climbing on cracks and knobs along an exposed ridge crest.
beta: The classic SW ridge of the highest peak in the range: the route begins with loose, blocky climbing low down, then the final two pitches offer delightful easy climbing on cracks and knobs along an exposed ridge to the summit. All routes in the Gunsight Range are short, and this one runs about 5 pitches.
gear: light trad rack (small-to-mid cams and stoppers)
